sourceText:
Sweet Anise Cookies
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Monday, July 30, 2012 - 11:18am

Ingredients




3 egg yolks
1 tsp baking soda
7 tbs. Butter
1 cup sugar
2 cups flour
Zest and juice of 1 lemon
1 tsp anise seeds

Preparation

1 Into a medium sized bowl, sift together the flour, sugar and baking soda and set aside. 2 In a mix master cream the butter and sugar.  While on low speed add the eggs, lemon juice and zest and the anise seeds. 3 While on low speed, slowly add the dry ingredients. 4 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 5 Roll into small walnut size balls and press down. 6 Place formed cookies on parchment paper or a butted cookie sheet. 7 Bake 10-12 minutes or until slightly golden. 8 Remove the cookies from the pan and place on a cooling rack.

About

These cookies taste like you just bought them at the bakery!
Enjoy with Love,
Catherine
xo
